text:
elaine: Heads-up: given the infra lag and late QA, we need to discuss MVP vs v1 cuts for milestone-14. Proposing two options:

A) Trim non-critical telemetry + tenant SSO pilot to v1.
B) Keep SSO but cut embeddings-cache warmups and nonessential rollout automation.

Thoughts?

mike: Option A sounds safer. SSO pilot is high-risk and could blow the roll.

sophie: Agreed A. Also can we move "retry semantics for bulk embeddings" to post-launch? That code churn isn't worth the risk.

vik: If we cut SSO pilot we need to update the roadmap + customer comms. Who owns that?

elaine: @mike can you own the customer note? @sophie can you confirm impact on metrics? We'll need a rollback plan either way.

mike: Yep — I'll draft a short note and ping CS. ETA EOD.

sophie: Quick perf note: cutting SSO-related auth checks should improve p50 latency ~15% on gen routes and cut CPU for auth workers. I'll run perf tomorrow morning and post numbers.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: milestone-14/v1 candidate pinned to model v2-rc @ infra-canal; 5% traffic. Status: healthy ✅

david: If canary is green by tomorrow noon we can keep a very small SSO alpha behind a feature flag (alpha tenants only). Suggest flag gating + 10% traffic.

elaine: Decision: go with Option A, but keep reduced SSO alpha behind a feature flag if canary is green. Action items:
- mike: draft customer comms
- sophie: perf verification
- vik: update roadmap & milestone doc
- david: coordinate canary flag and alpha list

Let's sync 10:30 AM PT tomorrow to confirm. :thumbsup:

mike: Committed — will post draft in #product-comm-channels when ready.

sophie: Perf run scheduled 07:00 PT, will post numbers here.

vik: Roadmap notes updated (https://redwood.atlassian.io/milestone-14) — opened PR for milestone page.

elaine: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the single source for scope decision.
